inquiry_guide_zh: 拖动数轴动点，观察有理数分类与正负数方向性。
inquiry_guide_en: Drag the dynamic point on the number line to observe the classification of rational numbers and the directionality of positive and negative numbers.

inquiry_guide_zh: 移动点P，直观探究数轴三要素与连续稠密性。
inquiry_guide_en: Move point P to intuitively explore the three elements of the number line and its continuous density.

inquiry_guide_zh: 拖动原点两侧动点，探究相反数对称性与绝对值距离本质。
inquiry_guide_en: Drag dynamic points on both sides of the origin to explore the symmetry of opposite numbers and the essence of absolute value distance.

inquiry_guide_zh: 拖动无理数点，观察与相邻有理数区间的无限逼近夹逼。
inquiry_guide_en: Drag the irrational number point to observe its infinite approximation and squeezing within adjacent rational number intervals.

inquiry_guide_zh: 调节斜率 k，观察正比例函数直线旋转与象限穿越。
inquiry_guide_en: Adjust the slope k to observe the rotation and quadrant crossing of the direct proportion function line.

inquiry_guide_zh: 拖动直线上两定点，观察待定系数法解析式动态重算。
inquiry_guide_en: Drag two fixed points on the line to observe the dynamic recalculation of the analytic expression using the method of undetermined coefficients.

inquiry_guide_zh: 调节截距 b 与斜率 k，探究一次函数单调增减性。
inquiry_guide_en: Adjust the intercept b and slope k to explore the monotonicity of the linear function.

inquiry_guide_zh: 移动直线交点，探究一次函数与二元方程组同解几何化。
inquiry_guide_en: Move the intersection point of the lines to explore the geometrization of common solutions between linear functions and systems of two-variable equations.

inquiry_guide_zh: 拖动双曲线动点，观察一三象限对称与无限渐近线。
inquiry_guide_en: Drag the dynamic point on the hyperbola to observe its symmetry in the first and third quadrants and its infinite asymptotes.
